node.install_hint: Install Node.js 24.19.0 LTS, then rerun the bootstrap command.

python.install_hint: Install Python 3.14.6 with uv or the Python install manager, then rerun bootstrap.

rust.install_hint: Install rustup and toolchain 1.96.1 with clippy and rustfmt, then rerun bootstrap.

pnpm.install_hint: Run corepack prepare pnpm@11.20.0 --activate under the pinned Node.js runtime.
